newsitem.title: USA: Sabratek wins Cleveland Clinic contract.
newsitem.headline: Sabratek wins Cleveland Clinic contract.

text.p: Sabratek Corp said Thursday it had received a three-year contract for its proprietary medical technology from the Cleveland Clinic.
Sabratek will provide its ambulatory pumps and software that monitors the pumps and collects clinical data. The equipment will be used for pain management.
Financial terms of the agreement were not announced.
Sabratek develops and markets high-tech medical infusion devices in addition to marketing computer software to monitor the equipment.
